gaps.sentence: She looks ___ on people who disagree with her.
gaps.explanation: look down on = consider inferior (opposite: look up to).

gaps.sentence: The film didn't live up ___ my expectations.
gaps.explanation: live up TO something = be as good as expected.

gaps.sentence: The fire blew ___ the gas cylinder exploded.
gaps.explanation: blow up = explode, or make something explode.

gaps.sentence: Police are looking ___ the cause of the crash.
The subject cropped ___ again at dinner.
gaps.explanation: crop up = appear or happen unexpectedly.

gaps.sentence: Please carry ___ with your work; don't mind me.
gaps.explanation: carry on = continue; carry out = perform (a task).

gaps.sentence: The deal fell ___ at the last minute.
gaps.explanation: fall through = (a plan/deal) fail to happen.

gaps.sentence: The flood wiped ___ the entire harvest.
